title: To "Heaven"
subtitle: Everything she's ever wanted—for a price.

items.text: On stage, footsteps move with a light, quick pace.
Do you wish to become immortal?
Mayfly looks up but sees nothing before her.
Do you wish to become immortal?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Only a fool would give up such a chance.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hm? Where am I?
Mayfly sits up from a comfy bed and looks around.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Eh!

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: This place is so luxurious.
She jumps to the floor and walks around the room, curious about her new surroundings.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: The bed's soft, and this blanket's so light and warm.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: What a strange dream I had, but, my, do I feel rested?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: *deep breath* I'm brimming with energy! I haven't felt this good since autumn. With strength like this flowing through me—

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I could till a whole field all on my own!

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: That vase is almost as big as me, but I bet I could lift it.
She finds herself standing in front of the vase in the corner, excitedly stretching out her hands to measure its height and width.
Hello, Mayfly.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Who-Who's that? Wait.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Paper Heron?
We were chatting outside your room when we heard your voice. I'm glad to see that you are doing well.
I know what you wish to ask. You are in the School of Mei.
The lady smiles and nods as she explains further.
And I am its founder. They call me Master Rén, or Rén the Immortal.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Rén the Immortal.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Th-Then, you must be the immortal everyone's been talking about?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Please, Master, teach me the Method of Longevity!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Hah hah. Another young soul looking too far ahead to see the truth before them.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: The immortal you seek is standing right in front of you, but it isn't me. In fact, I was one of her students.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: What?
Mayfly shifts her focus between Master Rén and Paper Heron before resting on the more comfortably familiar face.
Saying nothing, Master Rén smiles and follows Mayfly's gaze to Paper Heron.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Heron? You mean, she's the immortal?!
Paper Heron stirs the sweet soup in her bowl. The white sugar has sunk to the bottom.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I'd prefer if you wouldn't call me that, Mayfly. Makes me feel as though I'm covered in ants.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: But how can that be?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Do you recall the evening passed?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Last night, I was pushed out on the stage, and then ...

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Precisely. It was then that Paper Heron held the longevity ritual for you. You fell into a deep slumber for the rest of the night.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: How do you feel now?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I feel refreshed, energetic, alive. Then, I've gained longevity already?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: No. This is but the first step.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Master Heron altered the flowing pattern of your Qi to imitate that of the Way, laying the foundation for true longevity cultivation.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: But this alone will not extend your life. To achieve true longevity, one must cultivate it through the method of our school. Worry not. I will be your guide.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I see. No, wait.
Mayfly looks puzzled; she counts her fingers, as if attempting to follow the logic to its conclusion.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Paper Heron, if you're Master Rén's master and the founder of the School of Mei ...

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Then you knew all along? You were just pretending?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Th-Then, you lied too! You know, I felt so guilty about leaving you behind!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I didn't deceive you. I had no inkling that it was Rén that you sought.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I only learned of her ritual on the stage at the last instant. I took her place as its officiator as a bit of fun.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But I looked quite splendid up there, don't you think? Didn't you notice it was me?
At this pleasant thought, Paper Heron spoons some of the sweet soup into her mouth.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: So it was you who slipped the amulet and the note into my pocket.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Of course. I hadn't cast that spell for some time, so I thought I'd seize the opportunity to give it a spin.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Ah, why the glum look, eh? Our performance was a great success. Yao have joined the school in spadefuls.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: They're here for the Method, not your magic tricks.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Ah, scythe me down. You're the immortal! How could I say such a thing?
Before Mayfly can finish, hurried steps outside cut her off.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hm?
The footsteps stop at the door, followed by whispers and the rustle of clothes.
Suddenly, a short, plump hedgehog and a yam with a leafy head peek out from behind the door. Then a gray rat, a shrew, and behind them, a whole parade of other Yao.

items.speaker: Noisy Yao
items.text: Immortal! Please, forgive our intrusion. We're here to see you and our new schoolmate.

items.speaker: Shy Yao
items.text: Grandmaster, our greatest thanks for these artifacts. We've brought a token of our gratitude. Though it's not so valuable, I hope it will suffice.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Oh, think nothing of it. Consider it a gift from your grandmaster.

items.speaker: Noisy Yao
items.text: Thank you, Immor—Uh, Grandmaster. Erm, if it's not too much trouble, could you teach us the spell you used on the stage last night?
Paper Heron waves their praise away with her hand, but the smile behind that waving hand reveals her joy.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Sure, it's not so difficult. Just say what more you want to learn, and I shall teach you.
The Yao pour in, talking excitedly with Paper Heron. Mayfly watches as her friend-turned-grandmaster enters the circle and shakes her head.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Ahem!
A few clear coughs cut the clamoring voices short.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Now, now, students. You ought to show respect in the presence of the grandmaster. Enough playfulness. You must all return to your cultivation.

items.speaker: Shy Yao
items.text: But I hear this is the first time the grandmaster has visited our school in many years. We only wanna talk to her.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And talk we shall.
Master Rén smiles.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: The grandmaster will be with us for many days. There will be plenty of time.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: For now, we ought to consider our newest schoolmate. You need some time to settle in, isn't that so, Mayfly?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Err ...

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You have just received the ritual. Your body needs time to adapt.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Students, will you show Mayfly around our school? A little bit of activity should do her good.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Ah, right. Best to get some exercise.

items.speaker: Noisy Yao
items.text: Whatever you say, Master.

items.speaker: Noisy Yao
items.text: Mayfly, is it? We brought you a gift too. Sorry, we got carried away after seeing the grandmaster.
The Yao bring out several boxes of herbs and steamers filled with cakes, all prepared in advance—a substantial offering.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: That's alright, and thank you for the gift. I feel so full of energy now. I'd love to look around.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: You should spend some time getting to know the other students. Your gift can wait.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Alright then. I can save it for later.
Mayfly pats her skirt and leaves with the Yao. Soon, she enters a busy courtyard bustling with the voices of other students of the School of Mei.

items.speaker: Noisy Yao
items.text: Stop it, Mayfly! That cauldron's too heavy! You could hurt yourself.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Heh heh. I was just like her back then. Didn't know what to do with my newfound strength.
Paper Heron lifts another spoonful of her sweet soup to her lips and then sets the bowl down.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: So, have you retrieved your five senses?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Hmm. Mmm.
Master Rén nods and waits for Paper Heron to swallow.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: No, it's become worse. Even clear soup is practically tasteless to me now. But enough about that; we have more important things to discuss.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: My divinations suggest that Lǎnzhū is waking. I have observed many omens along the road.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Birds migrating north, withered grass blackening. Ere long, Lǎnzhū will awaken.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Unlike other Xiǎndào Beasts, Lǎnzhū is not under Zhènzǐ's control. The quake it wrought brought great suffering to the Huanzhou region.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: The White Horse School once fought it, and I among them, yet we could only force it into a long slumber.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Until the Way bestowed on us two Swords of Longevity, allowing ordinary students to control the Qi of Yin and Yang in order to pacify Lǎnzhū.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But then ...
She pauses.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You need not say more.
Master Rén draws an array in the air. It glows gold for a moment, then fades as a white sword appears.
Paper Heron stares intently at the sword. It floats in the air, radiating with a soft white glow.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Now, only one sword remains.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: And the White Horse School is no more.
Her hands shake as she grips it, as if she were holding it too tightly.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You needn't worry. Since the moment you passed the sword to me, I have been making preparations to face Lǎnzhū.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: I know the consequences if I fail. The earth will split, and beneath the dual sun and moon, disaster and disorder will reign.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Zhu County, all of Huanzhou, will shatter, causing untold devastation.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: That is why I founded the School of Mei to gather strength in numbers.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Though I wield the last Sword of Longevity, if it should fail, I have prepared a Quelling Array. But I will need their strength to help me activate it.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Oh!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Do I surprise you?
Paper Heron looks around the room and answers with a sigh.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Ah, no. It's just ... You were but a little Yao when we first met beneath that tree. Look how you've grown.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Heh heh. A Yao's life is shorter than most. We must make every day count.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You entrusted this task to me, and I will do all that I must to finish it.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: I will allow nothing to get in my way. Not only for the sake of the school, but for the sake of everyone in this land.
She sees Rén's smile. Paper Heron pauses, then offers an affirming smile to her old student.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: You are more prepared than I could ever hope to be. But mind your students well. I should not like to see your school meet the same fate as mine, eh?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I will stay here until the task is done. And intervene if need be.
Master Rén replies with a solemn nod.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Grandmaster, you gave me a second life and the Sword of Longevity. I owe my life to you.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: I swear I will complete the suppression, no matter the cost. For you and for your school.
